newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish musical takes escapism too far, MPs say.
newsitem.headline: Irish musical takes escapism too far, MPs say.

text.p: Ticket sales for a musical in an Irish prison were suspended on Wednesday after politicians complained prisoners might use the occasion to escape.
Prisoners and professional actors were due to mount a production of "West Side Story' in Dublin's Mountjoy Prison in November and tickets for the show were on sale in Dublin shops.

But opposition politician Liz O'Donnell said this posed a serious security risk. "How will prison officers be sure that the crowd they let in at the start of the night will be the crowd who walk out at the end?" she asked in parliament.
The government said it was suspending ticket sales and would investigate whether the event was a threat to security.
